summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing Amendment No. 1 to its Agreement and Plan of Merger dated April 19, 2026, to acquire SVRE Holdings Ltd. (target) via a merger where SVRE will merge into a wholly owned BVI subsidiary of USAR. The amendment adds conditions requiring that an offtake agreement for rare earth materials remain in full force and be non-terminable at closing. No financial terms (price per share, premium, valuation) are disclosed. USAR’s board recommended the merger; no advisor named. The deal structure is a reverse triangular merger of BVI entities as a stock-for-stock acquisition. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory clearance under CFIUS/HSR; risk arises if offtake conditions fail.
